policy: Direct published names/defaults remain unchanged. Actual recursive /children/{id}/children operations use source-backed distinct NestedChild nouns. No endpoint selector, authoring flag, grouped mutation, route deletion, or unmerged framework dependency.
defaultProof: All 84 defaults uniquely proven Direct by pinned Learn Default syntax at MicrosoftDocs/microsoftgraph-docs-powershell commit 07b0cf8f6305213f3c3830c301fca69a3e82ed17 and actual same-profile method/path-ID contracts. dispatchPolicy: Ordinary automatic list/item pairing only; distinct recursive names remove ambiguous same-ID and mutation-collision groups. Existing runtime derived profile is separate from all shared authoring.
